title: Provenance
summary: A museum provenance panel for a web document whose chain of custody the browser can count but, for privacy, must redact.
mechanism: history.length and document.referrer read as the chain of custody, extended live by history.pushState; every owner rendered as a blacked-out ledger line because the privacy web discloses none.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
